Gemini.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
Gemini.why: Google's November 10, 2026 post calls Gemini 4 Carbon its strongest model and says it is now available in the paid Gemini API as gemini-4-carbon, making it stronger than Gemini 4 Argon, while Gemini 4 Hydrogen is the faster, more efficient tier.

Claude.name: Claude Fable 5.2
Claude.why: Anthropic calls Claude Fable 5.2, released November 9, 2026, its most capable generally available model and gives claude-fable-5-2 as its API ID; the more powerful Mythos 5.2 is restricted-access and not on this account's list.

ChatGPT.name: GPT-6 Astra
ChatGPT.why: OpenAI calls GPT-6 Astra its most intelligent model and says it is available in the API; the newer GPT-6.1 Sol and Terra are cheaper tiers, and OpenAI says Sol only nearly matches Astra.

Grok.name: Grok 4.7
Grok.why: xAI's API docs mark Grok 4.7 as its latest model and its developer guide calls it the frontier model for coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work; it replaced Grok 4.6 on September 21, 2026.
